original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an AWS Lambda function named 'order-processor' triggered by an SQS queue, written in Python 3.12.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an AWS Lambda function named 'order-processor' triggered by an SQS queue, written in Python 3.12.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for order-processor Lambda function triggered by SQS'

Parameters:
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: order-processor
    Description: Name of the Lambda function

  LambdaRuntime:
    Type: String
    Default: python3.12
    Description: Lambda runtime environment

  LambdaMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 128
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: Memory size for Lambda function in MB

  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: Timeout for Lambda function in seconds

  SQSQueueName:
    Type: String
    Default: order-processor-queue
    Description: Name of the SQS queue

  SQSVisibilityTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Visibility timeout for SQS queue in seconds

  SQSMessageRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 345600
    Description: Message retention period for SQS queue in seconds

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${LambdaFunctionName}-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SQSReadPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                Resource: !GetAtt OrderProcessorQueue.Arn

  OrderProcessorQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Ref SQSQueueName
      VisibilityTimeout: !Ref SQSVisibilityTimeout
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !Ref SQSMessageRetentionPeriod
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt OrderProcessorDLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  OrderProcessorDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${SQSQueueName}-dlq'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
      Runtime: !Ref LambdaRuntime
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              for record in event['Records']:
                  try:
                      message_body = json.loads(record['body'])
                      logger.info(f"Processing order: {message_body}")
                      # Add order processing logic here
                  except Exception as e:
                      logger.error(f"Error processing message: {str(e)}")
                      raise e
              
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps('Messages processed successfully')
              }
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO
          QUEUE_URL: !Ref OrderProcessorQueue

  EventSourceMapping:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::EventSourceMapping
    Properties:
      BatchSize: 10
      Enabled: true
      EventSourceArn: !GetAtt OrderProcessorQueue.Arn
      FunctionName: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
      MaximumBatchingWindowInSeconds: 0

Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the order-processor Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn

  SQSQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the SQS queue
    Value: !Ref OrderProcessorQueue

  SQSQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the SQS queue
    Value: !GetAtt OrderProcessorQueue.Arn

  SQSDeadLetterQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the SQS dead letter queue
    Value: !Ref OrderProcessorDLQ
